CXDYNAMIQ allows you to automate your dispatching processes while regarding genuine limitations to bring productivity, straightforwardness and consistency in your omnichannel retailing.CXDYNAMIQ allows you to utilize existing retail infrastructure to build your omnichannel platform. Subsequently helping you to achieve same day door-step deliveries to your clients. Omnichannel executives after consideration of business elements including SKU bifurcation, retail outlet work timings, regulatory constraints and so on for the improved dispatch plans. Omnichannel ideal fleet mix (once just as day by day powerful designs) for satisfaction operations.
CXDYNAMIQ Auto dialers come packed with every tool and feature you need to run a successful inbound campaign.
